name: mirage
text: Mostly wasteful, though cheap. The engine already checks every API on its own every 5 minutes, and a failing one every 30 s to 2 min. Those checks are free account reads that don't use credits. A pull to refresh adds another round from the phone and asks the engine to check everything again. That was added on 10-21 so the API screen is accurate right after you pull. It costs some phone data and a few seconds, and it can put a little pressure on providers with tight limits, such as one connection or a request every few seconds. The check only matters when an API has failed or its last reading is old. I'd change it so a pull re-tests only APIs that are failing or whose last check is more than about 60 s old, and leaves healthy ones alone. You'd still see current status, with fewer calls. Want me to build that?
